'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Snake Island during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[List of military occupations]]
****[[Russia]] announces that it has withdrawn from [[Snake Island (Ukraine)|Snake Island]], in the [[Black Sea]], as a "gesture of goodwill", ending the occupation of the island that began in February. However, [[Ukraine]] says that it drove out [[Russian forces]] from the island after a massive [[artillery]] assault. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-steps-up-attacks-ukraine-after-landmark-nato-summit-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict in 2022]]
***Two [[Israelis|Israeli]] civilians and a [[Israel Defense Forces|soldier]] are injured after [[Palestinian]] [[militant]]s open fire inside [[Joseph's Tomb]] in [[Nablus]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-710776 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[2019–2022 Sudanese protests]]
**Eight protesters are killed by [[Sudan]]ese security forces in [[Omdurman]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/internet-cut-sudans-capital-ahead-pro-democracy-protests-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*For the first time since Russia began occupying the Ukrainian city of [[Berdiansk]], a [[cargo ship]] departs from the city's port. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/first-cargo-ship-leaves-ukraines-occupied-port-berdyansk-official-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]] 
**Hurricane watches are issued for [[Nicaragua]] and [[Costa Rica]] as [[2022 Atlantic hurricane season#Potential Tropical Cyclone Two|Potential Tropical Cyclone Two]] is expected to form into Tropical Storm Bonnie in the coming hours. [https://www.wmbfnews.com/2022/06/30/first-alert-hurricane-watch-issued-central-america-bonnie-expected-form-thursday/ (WMBF-TV)]
*[[2022 Manipur landslide]]
**Nineteen people are killed, and 48 others are feared dead, after a massive [[landslide]] in [[Manipur]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/seven-dead-55-feared-dead-massive-eastern-indian-landslide-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*Four people are killed and three others injured after a jeep carrying migrants crashes into a trailer in [[Encinal, Texas|Encinal]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/four-migrants-killed-texas-crash-days-after-trailer-tragedy-2022-07-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Kathy Hochul]] announces that [[New York (state)|the state]] will distribute more than 8,000 doses of the [[smallpox vaccine]] to help combat the spread of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/06/30/nyregion/monkeypox-vaccine-ny.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic and animals]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Columbus, Ohio]]
*****An [[Siberian tiger|Amur]] [[tiger]] at the [[Columbus Zoo and Aquarium]] in [[Columbus, Ohio|Columbus]], [[Ohio]], U.S., dies from [[COVID-19]], making it the first animal at the zoo to die from the disease. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/tiger-dies-after-contracting-covid-columbus-zoo-ohio-jupiter/ (CBS News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nauru]]
***[[Nauru]] surpasses 3,000 cases of COVID-19, about a third of the country's population. [https://www.loopnauru.com/nauru-news/covid-19-cases-nauru-now-over-3000-113848 (Loop)]
*[[Climate change in the United States]]
**[[Climate change policy of the United States]]
***''[[West Virginia v. EPA]]''
****In a 6–3 decision, the [[Supreme Court of the United States|Supreme Court]] rules that the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency|Environmental Protection Agency]] has not received [[United States Congress|legislative]] authorization under the [[Clean Air Act (United States)|Clean Air Act]] to introduce regulations on [[carbon dioxide emissions]] from power plants by compelling them to change the resources from which they generate the power. This will likely reduce the United States' ability to address its environmental goals. [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/06/30/supreme-court-handcuffs-biden-on-major-climate-rule-00043423 (''Politico'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-62000742 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 European heat waves]]
**[[June 2022 European heat wave]]
***[[Slovakia]] measures the highest ever temperature in June in [[Somotor]] near [[Košice]], reaching {{cvt|38.8|C|F}}. [https://dolnyzemplin.korzar.sme.sk/c/22951459/horucavy-v-somotore-prekonali-junovy-rekord-meteorologovia-namerali-388-stupna.html (''Korzár Dolny Zemplín - SME'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[New Zealand–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] signs a [[free trade agreement]] with [[New Zealand]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-new-zealand-deal-standard-greener-trade/ (''Politico'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**The [[Supreme Administrative Court of Poland]] upholds lower court rulings that annulled [[anti-LGBT]] resolutions, known as "[[LGBT-free zone]]s", that had been adopted by some local authorities. [https://notesfrompoland.com/2022/06/29/polish-top-court-upholds-annulment-of-anti-lgbt-resolutions/ (''Notes from Poland'')]
*Aftermath of the [[Russo-Georgian War]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] asks for the arrest of three [[South Ossetia]]n servicemen for alleged [[war crime]]s during the 2008 conflict. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/30/international-criminal-court-demands-three-to-be-arrested-for-war-crimes-during-2008-georg (Euronews)]
*[[2022 shooting of Kentucky police officers]]
**Two police officers and a police dog are killed, and six other people are injured, in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Allen, Kentucky]], United States. The suspect, on whom the officers were attempting to serve a warrant, is later taken into custody. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/police-officers-wounded-eastern-kentucky-shooting-86052607 (ABC News)] [https://www.wsaz.com/2022/07/02/wsaz-gets-first-look-home-where-mass-shooting-happened/ (WSAZ)]
*[[New Zealand]] designates American [[far-right]] groups [[Proud Boys]] and [[The Base (hate group)|The Base]] as [[terrorist organization]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/canada-religion-new-zealand-race-and-ethnicity-racial-injustice-aaf63aaa32fbe9ccd2d46e8ff5d417f3 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Presidency of Bongbong Marcos]]
**[[Inauguration of Bongbong Marcos]]
***[[Bongbong Marcos]] is sworn in as the 17th [[President of the Philippines]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/dictators-son-marcos-jr-taking-oath-as-philippine-president/2022/06/29/81b1341e-f816-11ec-81db-ac07a394a86b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Provinces of Indonesia]]
**Three new provinces are created in [[Western New Guinea|West Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-passes-contentious-law-create-more-provinces-papua-2022-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2019–2022 Israeli political crisis]]
**[[2022 Israeli legislative election]]
***The [[Knesset]] votes to disband itself and sets November 1 as the date for the new elections. [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel)|Foreign Minister]] and Alternate Prime Minister [[Yair Lapid]] will succeed [[Naftali Bennett]] as [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] until a new government is formed. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/knesset-disbands-sets-elections-for-november-1-lapid-to-become-pm-at-midnight/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Judiciary of Kiribati]]
**The [[Kiribati]] High Court is left judgeless as the [[Government of Kiribati|government of the country]] fires the only judge sitting on the bench at the time. The other judge had also been ordered to step down. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/01/kiribati-faces-constitutional-crisis-after-government-suspends-both-high-court-justices (''The Guardian'')]
